methods.name: assignGlRecToFinAccTrans
methods.description: Assigns a GL Reconciliation to a FinAccountTrans and updates related payment statuses, validating the reconciliation status before assignment.

methods.name: removeFinAccountTransFromReconciliation
methods.description: Removes a FinAccountTrans from a reconciliation if it is in the correct status.

methods.name: isGlReconciliationReconciled
methods.description: Checks if all FinAccountTrans associated with a given GL Reconciliation are in the 'created' status, indicating reconciliation status.

methods.name: cancelBankReconciliation
methods.description: Cancels the bank reconciliation by clearing the glReconciliationId from associated FinAccountTrans.

methods.name: getAssociatedAcctgTransEntriesWithFinAccountTrans
methods.description: Retrieves accounting transaction entries associated with a given FinAccountTrans, including related payments.

methods.name: getReconciliationClosingBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the closing balance of a GL Reconciliation, based on its opening and reconciled balances.

methods.name: autoFinAccountReconciliation
methods.description: Performs an automated reconciliation of financial account transactions within the current day, matching unreconciled transactions.
